evaluationSummary: Reevaluation 2024-09 (fictional results): WISC-V Full Scale IQ 104; Working Memory 86; Processing Speed 82. Teacher rating scales show significant difficulty with sustained attention and task completion. Eligibility documentation is on file with the school; no health details are recorded here. Georgia Milestones Grade 3 (spring 2026): ELA Proficient Learner; Mathematics Developing Learner.
strengths: Happy reads on grade level, contributes creative ideas in discussion, and does well with hands-on science and building tasks.
needs: Staying on task during independent work, finishing assignments, math fact fluency, organizing written paragraphs.
parentConcerns: Homework takes a very long time; his family wants him to be more independent with work routines.
disabilityImpact: Difficulty sustaining attention and organizing multi-step tasks reduces Happy's work completion and accuracy across subjects.

presentLevels.text: Reads grade 4 text at benchmark; comprehension is strong when passages are chunked.
Multiplication facts: 20 digits correct in 2 minutes (grade 4 target about 40). Multi-digit procedures are accurate when he slows down.
Writes 2-3 related sentences; paragraphs lack a topic sentence and conclusion (rubric 2/5).
On task in 45% of 10-second momentary time samples during 15-minute independent work blocks. Completes about 50% of independent work in the time given.

specialFactors.notes: Self-monitoring app or checklist and a visual timer.

transition.note: Not required: the student is in elementary school (Georgia requires a transition plan by 9th grade entry or age 16).
